description: This file defines functions and types related to approval delivery plans in an approval-native system, including resolving delivery plans based on adapter capabilities and preferences.

methods.name: buildTargetKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for a target based on its 'to' and 'threadId' properties.

methods.name: dedupeTargets
methods.description: Removes duplicate targets from an array based on their generated keys.

methods.name: resolveChannelNativeApprovalDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a delivery plan for approval requests based on adapter capabilities and preferences.
